newsitem.title: USA: Mead files shelf for $550 mln debt offer.
newsitem.headline: Mead files shelf for $550 mln debt offer.

text.p: Mead Corp filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration for up to $550 million in debt securities.
When added to previously registered securities that remain unsold, the company will have up to $850 million of debt securities available for sale, according to the filing.
Net proceeds will be added to the working capital of the company and used for general corporate purposes, which may include repayment of debt, the filing said.
The company, based in Dayton, Ohio, manufactures and sells paper, pulp, paperboard and other wood products.
No underwriters were listed in the filing.
